description: EF Core Oracle provider infers NVARCHAR2(2000) for string with no MaxLength

expectedDiagnostics.messageContains: EF Core will infer NVARCHAR2(2000) for property 'Content' (no MaxLength set, Unicode=true) but Oracle column 'CONTENT' is CLOB

notes: Per dotnet/efcore#33218, EF Core Oracle provider falls back to NVARCHAR2(2000) when string property has no MaxLength and IsUnicode=true. This can cause ORA-12899 if values exceed 2000 characters.
